change_summary: fail-closed tool declaration and capability precheck; event envelope mapped to run_events.event_id/safe_payload; actor is a trusted case-sensitive Engine principal

compatibility.adapter_policy: model and execution adapters are replaceable; HarnessRuntime is the only dispatcher
compatibility.permission_entry: runtime rejects undeclared names; declared capabilities must match grant paths or argv
compatibility.tool_policy: fail closed; read/write tools require path arguments, execute tools require argv
compatibility.event_projection: cursor=app.run_events.event_id; envelope_id/operation_id/execution_epoch/revision/payload are inside safe_payload schema harness-event-v1
compatibility.actor_semantics: trusted case-sensitive Engine principal mapped by SA02; raw SourceActorRef is stored separately and never lowercased or inferred from text
compatibility.budget_entry: BudgetLedger.reserve before every model and tool call
compatibility.unknown_outcome: mark_unknown keeps the reservation and forbids automatic retry
